Paragraph:
Three chalcogenide compounds were investigated: ZnS, ZnSe and ZnTe. The powders were prepared by solid-state reaction and ground for 30 minutes. X-ray diffraction confirmed the sphalerite structure for all three. Lattice parameters refined to 5.41, 5.67 and 6.10 A respectively. Subsequent optical measurements gave band gaps of 3.68, 2.70 and 2.25 eV, respectively.
